svg.aria-label: An object with one accepted WebSocket. 1: a request starts the Rivet Actor and the object instance, which accepts a socket. 2: after 10 seconds with no event, Orange drops the instance; the actor and the socket stay. 3: a message on the socket builds a new instance. 4: the socket closes. 5: after 10 more idle seconds, the actor sleeps. 6: the next request wakes the actor with a new instance.
